description: Handwritten Peanut Butter Fudge card (Mrs. Bray). Tricky parts: the chocolate/cocoa ingredient line and the 'boil until it forms a soft ball' line are crossed out, so they should not be in the recipe; notes are squeezed in sideways ('mix with sugar', '50% ... little water', 'med heat + bring to boil + cook for 3-4 min'); some amounts are hard to read (the peanut butter amount, the cook time). A good draft flags the unclear parts instead of guessing silently.
